description.narrative: Enraf-Nonius B.V. specialises in providing turnkey solutions for the realisation of complete medical clinics and hospitals.Health Access International B.V. advises and supports international clients in realising digital healthcare projects.Both companies have been asked to use their expertise for a healthcare company in Kenya. Imperio Medical Group Ltd. (Imperio) currently operates two private clinics in Nairobi, where they provide specialised treatments in various medical areas. The company has big plans for the future and wants to increase the quality, effectiveness and range of care.Imperio wants to invest in a digital healthcare platform that increases access to care for large groups of people and the realisation of two to four additional and modernisation of existing clinics and specialist medical equipment for the expansion of more medical specialties.The plans cover a period of several years and will be developed and implemented in phases.This application concerns the first phase, with the focus on the realisation of a digital care network that can be used by patients via regional care centers and mobile apps. The plan is to first introduce a "maternity app" for mobile phones that will allow healthcare professionals to communicate with their patients.In a later phase, this will be expanded to apps for other medical specialties. Particularly through the digital healthcare network, Imperio will become much more productive and will also be able to provide better care, thus helping to reduce healthcare costs in Kenya, because there will be more prevention.
